page.overview:
Who is James McClure?

James McClure is the lead network engineer of Mascom.

James was involved in the construction of Masrani Global Corporation's Jurassic World. He isolated an anomaly in Jurassic World's system in 2004. After he felt it was "watertight" he sent an email to an undisclosed recipient telling the recipient what he had accomplished and that he would give Vic Hoskins a call to see if there was anything that needed to be updated.

By 2014, he was the lead network engineer of Mascom.
